title: Final exam arrangements
message:
Dear students,

The final examination of CS3201 will be held on 8 December 2026 from 09:30 to 11:30 in LT-5 (Academic 1, level 4). It is a closed-book exam; one A4 double-sided cheat sheet is allowed. Please bring your student card and arrive 15 minutes early. The exam covers all topics from Week 1 to Week 12, with emphasis on transport-layer reliability, congestion control and routing algorithms. Past papers from 2023 and 2024 are uploaded under Files > Past Papers. A revision tutorial will be held on 2 December at 14:00 in the usual tutorial room.
